questions.stem: Which is the negation of ∀x ∃y (x + y = 0)?
questions.explain: Negating flips each quantifier (∀ becomes ∃ and ∃ becomes ∀) and negates the inside, giving ∃x ∀y (x + y ≠ 0).

questions.stem: A binary operation on a set S is a function from S × S to S. If S has 4 elements, how many elements does S × S have?
questions.explain: S × S is all ordered pairs, with 4 choices for each slot: 4 × 4 = 16.

questions.stem: The relation “x ≡ y (mod 4)” on the integers is an equivalence relation. How many equivalence classes does it have?
questions.explain: Two integers are related when they leave the same remainder on division by 4, and the remainders are 0, 1, 2 and 3.

questions.stem: A function f from {1, 2, 3, 4} to {a, b, c, d} is one-to-one. What else must be true?
options: Its inverse is not a function
It is also onto, so it is a bijection
questions.explain: A one-to-one map uses 4 different outputs out of 4, so every output is hit and f is a bijection.
